newsitem.title: USA: CinemaStar controlling stake to be sold.
newsitem.headline: CinemaStar controlling stake to be sold.

text.p: CinemaStar Luxury Theaters Inc said Thursday it had agreed in principle for an investor group led by an Austin, Texas, venture capital firm to buy $15 million of newly issued CinemaStar common shares.
Rust Capital Ltd and its partners will own not less than a 51 percent stake in CinemaStar on a fully diluted basis when the deal is completed, CinemaStar said.
The group's stake may be raised above 51 percent under a formula tied to CinemaStar's financial condition at closing, which is expected by mid-September, it said.
CinemaStar said completion of the transaction is subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement, due diligence, regulatory and shareholder approval, and other conditions.
It said it would reconstitute its board to reflect the majority interest of the Rust Capital group after the deal is completed.

CinemaStar said it currently operates seven first-run movie theaters and will have a total of 69 screens in Southern Californina after its Ultraplex 13 location at Mission Marketplace in Oceanside, Calif., opens next week.
